title: Register-blocked GEMM microkernel: outer-product accumulate (CUDA)
info: size_ratio is reported for context (naive_transactions / regblock_transactions), computed from real simulator launches; it is not gated because this simulator counts memory transactions per program STEP, so fewer threads each issuing more sequential loads (register blocking's actual mechanism) isn't rewarded the way shared-memory tiling is -- the graded work is getting the outer-product accumulation correct
